name: normal_pauses
description: 3 minutes of lively turns with pauses up to 3 s: no automatic crumbs.

turns.text: So I just got back from a climbing trip in Colorado last weekend.
No way, I have always wanted to go climbing out there. Which area?
We were near Boulder, mostly the Flatirons, which honestly have the best views ever.
That sounds amazing, I mostly climb indoors at the gym near campus right now.
Indoor is great for training though, do you boulder or do top rope routes?
Mostly bouldering, my friends dragged me there freshman year and I got hooked.
Same thing happened to me with running, a friend signed me up for a race.
Did you end up liking it or was it pure suffering the whole time?
Honestly both, but now I am training for my first half marathon in March.
That is so cool, what does your training look like on a normal week?
Three short runs and one long run on Sundays, plus a lot of stretching.
I respect that so much, I can barely get up for my eight am class.
The trick is coffee and a playlist that makes you feel like a movie hero.
Okay what is on the playlist, I need to know the hero songs immediately.
Lots of old film scores, and a weird amount of nineties pop if I am honest.
Nineties pop is elite, my parents played it in the car on every road trip.
Where did you go on road trips growing up, anywhere really memorable?
We drove to the Grand Canyon once and my brother got carsick the entire way.
Oh no, that sounds like a classic family story you get to tell forever.
He still refuses to talk about it, which makes it even funnier at dinner.
My family stories are mostly about my grandma and her very competitive card games.
Competitive card games are the best, what does she play with everyone?
Mostly rummy, and she has never once let anyone win, not even the little kids.
That is the right way to raise champions, I would have loved that growing up.
We also cooked a lot together, she taught me how to make dumplings from scratch.
From scratch is serious, I can only make ramen and that is a stretch honestly.
Ramen counts if you add an egg and some green onions, that is real cooking.
Then I am basically a chef, I will put that on my resume next semester.
What are you studying anyway, I feel like we skipped the boring intro part?
Computer science with a minor in design, mostly because I like making things.
